findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed caulking to be showing black mold to the right of dish machine. Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure caulking is being monitored/replaced as needed to prevent black mold buildup.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment, and linens: properly stored, dried, and handled.
findings.comment: Observed drawer holding clean utensils to be soiled with food debris. Discussed with PIC, utensils were removed and put through the wash, rinse, and sanitize process. While utensils were removed, PIC cleaned and sanitized drawer. Ensure clean utensils are stored in a way that prevents contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(A) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (A) Except as specified in (D) of this section, cleaned EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, laundered LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be stored: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed caulking to be showing black mold to the right of dish machine. Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure caulking is being monitored/replaced as needed to prevent black mold buildup.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
(P) 4-501.114: A chemical sanitizer used in a sanitizing solution shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions.

The sani bucket is observed with a concentration of approximately 10 ppm CL. The bleach bottle states that a solution used for food contact surfaces should be 185 ppm. Education took place with the PIC and the bucket was remade to correct concentration.

findings.title: Proper hygienic practices, eating/drinking/smoking (evidence)
findings.comment:
750-530a Employees shall consume food only in designated dining areas. An employee dining area shall not be so designated if consuming food there may result in contamination of other food, equipment, utensils, or other items needing protection.

Observed a bottle of water intended for personal use to be stored in the walk in cooler. The facility has a shelf designated for personal foods in the 3 door cooler. Foods intended for personal use should be kept separate from foods intended for consumers. The bottle was moved to the correct location during the inspection.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed two small leaks at the three compartment sink when faucet is turned on. Repair the leaks.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Observed sanitizer that is used to wipe tables in the cafeteria to have no sanitizer.  Sanitizer was changed to ~100ppm to correct the violation.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.comment: Observed one live adult roach in the mop sink.  Terminix is the facility's pest control operator and sprays one time a month.  Increase frequency.  No other pests found during the inspection.
findings.citation_text: 750.1160 Effective measures intended to minimize the presence of rodents, flies, roaches, insect on the premises shall be utilized.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Observed the mops stored in the mop sink.  Mops should be inverted or hung to dry.  Properly store the mops.
750-1160 The premises shall be kept in such a condition to prevent the harborage or feeding of insects or rodents.

findings.title: Sanitizing temperature
findings.comment:
Dishmachine rinse temperature was at 120 degrees F.  Booster heater was reset and it is now at 195 degrees F.  Be sure to check the rinse temperature is over 180 degrees F daily.
750-830 All hot water for sanitizing dishes and equipment must be a minimum of 180F when it leaves the dishwashing machine manifold in order to kill pathogens.  Properly sanitize all items. Check and maintain the dishwasher frequently.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
The gauge indicating the rinse temperature on the dish machine was not working properly.  Repair the gauge so that it is working properly, so that the rinse temperature can be monitored.
750-830c A thermometer ±3°F shall be provided to check the temperature of  the water in each tank of the dish machine and the temperature of  the final rinse water as it enters the manifold.

findings.title: Sanitizing temperature
findings.comment:
The dish machine was not getting hot enough to properly sanitize the dishes.  Two heat test strips were used and neither turned dark to indicate the dish machine was hot enough to sanitize properly.  The dish machine will be used to wash the dishes and then they will be chemically sanitized in the 3 compartment sink until it can be repaired.  A service call was placed during inspection for Hobart to repair unit.   A spot check will be conducted when inspector is in Auburn again to verify that the dishmachine is reaching at least 180 degrees F during the rinse cycle.
750-830 All hot water for sanitizing dishes and equipment must be a minimum of 180F when it leaves the dishwashing machine manifold in order to kill pathogens.  Properly sanitize all items. Check and maintain the dishwasher frequently.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 800:  The baffle of the ice machine is soiled and showing slight sign of mold accumulation. Clean and sanitize the baffle.
